note: No production or test change was needed; the existing RISC-V64 owners and the end-to-end ingestion test cover the contract.
covered: architecture 0x8006 accepts only the 528-byte version-1 context with flags 0x08000001 or 0x08000003
short, long, wrong-version, floating-point-only, unknown-flag and wrong-architecture contexts are rejected
PC, SP=x2, FP=x8 and LR=x1 are decoded and x0 stays zero
the frame record reads fp-16 and fp-8, requires captured memory, monotonic nonzero unique frames and caps at 64
LR supplies the first caller when the frame record chain yields none; SP never supplies a guessed return address
the HTTP Minidump route ingests and stores a RISC-V64 crash
limits: No final image or public CI was exercised.
The product is not declared an acceptance candidate or closed.
